purpose: Teach: 岩波書店/ワーキング/大学院生/読了/セーブ/日弁連/コンディション/クラッシュ

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、岩波書店刊の判例集も活用されますね
lines.en: The police department does make use of case law collections published by Iwanami, don't they?
lines.style: Conversational, slightly formal. Gentle upward lift at the end—this is a confirmatory statement, not quite a question. Respectful curiosity. Warm but measured.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、ワーキンググループでの捜査もされますね
lines.en: And I imagine investigative work through working groups is part of the process too?
lines.style: Continuing the same thoughtful thread. Soft, collaborative tone. Slight pause before speaking—thinking alongside the listener. Encouraging them to elaborate.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、大学院生向けの講演もされますね
lines.en: You also give lectures for graduate students, don't you?
lines.style: Admiring, gentle. The tone of someone who already knows the answer and is inviting the person to share that part of themselves. Light warmth beneath the question.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、調書の読了確認を上司におこなわれますね
lines.en: And statement review confirmation with supervisors—that's something you handle too?
lines.style: Steady, professional interest. Slight lean-in. This is genuine inquiry about process, not skepticism. Even-paced, collaborative.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯カメラ映像のセーブを徹底されますね
lines.en: Security camera footage preservation—I gather that's taken quite seriously in your work?
lines.style: Approving nod in the voice. Understands the weight of this detail. Calm, matter-of-fact confirmation. No rush.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、日弁連と連携した冤罪防止策もされますね
lines.en: Working with the Japan Federation of Bar Associations on false confession prevention—that's part of what you do as well?
lines.style: Respectful recognition of something important. Slightly longer phrasing shows careful thought. Warm approval woven through professional tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、現場警官のコンディション管理もされますね
lines.en: You're also mindful about the fieldwork conditions and wellbeing of officers on the ground?
lines.style: Genuine care in the tone. This question matters. Slower pace. Not performative—just real concern about human detail.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、システムクラッシュ時の手動対応もできますね
lines.en: And even when systems fail, you have manual procedures in place to keep things running?
lines.style: Slightly more decisive than before. Respect for competence and resilience. Approving, steady. A touch of admiration for the preparation.
